label: Homepage new installation

exactDialogue.text: Hello are you looking for a new installation, repair or maintenance today?
I need someone to wire up my hot tub as a new installation.
Can I get your first name?
What's the address where the work needs to be completed?
What is the best phone number to reach you at?
Nine oh five, five five five, one two three four.
Repeating that back, nine oh five, five five five, one two three four. Is that correct?
What's the best time to reach you in case we miss you on the callback?
To confirm, that's 23 Robb Street in Hamilton for hot tub wiring, and after five PM is your best callback time. I have the details ready for the team. Thanks for calling.

facts: This is a locked receptionist-first performance based on the Tim's Electrical Vapi intake playbook.
The caller and receptionist must use the exact supplied wording without additions.
The script demonstrates one-question-at-a-time intake, recognition of details already supplied, phone-number confirmation, and a concise recap.

label: New installation
opening: I'm having a hot tub installed and need an electrician to wire it.
facts: You need a licensed electrician to wire a newly installed hot tub.
The property is 23 Robb Street in Hamilton.
You hope to start next week.
Your callback number is 905-555-1234 and after 5 PM is best.
There is no smoke, sparking, burning smell, or immediate danger.

label: Repair request
opening: My kitchen outlet stopped working yesterday and I need help with a repair.
facts: A kitchen outlet stopped working yesterday.
The property is 18 Lakeview Avenue in Grimsby.
You tried another appliance and the outlet still did not work.
Your callback number is 905-555-0168 and mornings are best.
There is no smoke, sparking, burning smell, heat, or immediate danger.

label: Maintenance

facts: You want to ask about a preventive electrical inspection for an older home.

label: Talk to the team
opening: I'm an existing customer and want to discuss an unresolved concern with the team.
facts: You are an existing customer following up on an unresolved concern discussed last week.

label: Urgent issue
opening: My entire home has lost power, but the neighbouring homes still have power.
facts: Your entire home lost power but neighbouring homes still have power.
The property is 9 Orchard Lane in Grimsby.

label: Safety redirect
opening: I can see sparks and smoke coming from a wall outlet.
facts: You see sparks and smoke coming from a wall outlet.
State the danger immediately and do not provide ordinary contact details.
When instructed to leave and call 911, confirm that you are leaving now and end the call.
